_meta.indication: Adult patients with locally advanced or metastatic urothelial carcinoma with susceptible FGFR3 or FGFR2 genetic alterations that has progressed during or following at least one line of prior platinum-containing chemotherapy, including within 12 months of neoadjuvant or adjuvant platinum-containing chemotherapy; select patients with an FDA-approved companion diagnostic.

pivotal_trials.design: Multicenter, open-label, single-arm study; major efficacy outcomes were objective response rate (ORR) and duration of response (DoR) by blinded independent review committee (BIRC) per RECIST v1.1.
pivotal_trials.population: Patients with locally advanced or metastatic urothelial carcinoma with FGFR3 gene mutations (R248C, S249C, G370C, Y373C) or FGFR gene fusions (FGFR3-TACC3, FGFR3-BAIAP2L1, FGFR2-BICC1, FGFR2-CASP7) whose disease had progressed on or after at least one prior chemotherapy.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Objective response rate (ORR) and duration of response (DoR) by BIRC per RECIST v1.1.
pivotal_trials.result: ORR 32.2% (95% CI 22.4, 42.0); CR 2.3%, PR 29.9%; median DoR 5.4 months (95% CI 4.2, 6.9). By alteration: FGFR3 point mutation (N=64) ORR 40.6%, FGFR3 fusion (N=18) ORR 11.1%, FGFR2 fusion (N=6) ORR 0.

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions including lab abnormalities (≥20%) were phosphate increased, stomatitis, fatigue, creatinine increased, diarrhea, dry mouth, onycholysis. In BLC2001 (N=87): stomatitis 56%, fatigue 54%, diarrhea 47%, dry mouth 45%, onycholysis 41%. Hyperphosphatemia was reported in 76% of patients; ocular disorders including central serous retinopathy/RPED are a warning.
target_moa: Erdafitinib is a kinase inhibitor that binds to and inhibits enzymatic activity of FGFR1, FGFR2, FGFR3 and FGFR4, inhibiting FGFR phosphorylation and signaling and decreasing cell viability in cell lines with FGFR genetic alterations.

rems.type: A REMS is not required to address ocular toxicity.

companion_dx_detail: therascreen FGFR RGQ RT-PCR Kit (QIAGEN), a real-time PCR test for qualitative detection of FGFR3 point mutations and FGFR gene fusions, approved as a companion diagnostic (PMA P180043) for selecting patients for BALVERSA.

advisory_committee.vote: This NDA was not presented to an advisory committee because the benefit-risk profile was clearly favorable and no controversial issues were identified.

surrogate_endpoint.text: Tumor response rate (ORR of 32.2% by BIRC in the 87-patient efficacy population).

citations.quote: This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on tumor response rate. Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in confirmatory trials.

The confirmed objective response rate (ORR) in the 87-patient efficacy population was 32.2% and the duration of response (DoR) was 5.4 months (95% CI: 4.2, 6.9) as determined by the Blinded Independent Review Committee (BIRC).

confirmatory_requirement.text: Confirmatory randomized Phase 3 trial BLC3001 comparing erdafitinib with vinflunine or docetaxel or pembrolizumab is required to verify and describe clinical benefit.

citations.quote: Erdafitinib is being approved under the provisions in 21 CFR Part 601 Subpart E (accelerated approval). A confirmatory trial(s) is therefore required to verify and describe the clinical benefit of erdafitinib in patients with urothelial carcinoma. The confirmatory randomized trial BLC3001 is ongoing (see Section 13 of this review).

basis.text: Erdafitinib is a breakthrough-therapy designated kinase inhibitor targeting susceptible FGFR genetic alterations.

citations.quote: Erdafitinib is a breakthrough-therapy designated kinase inhibitor targeting susceptible FGFR genetic alterations, that is under review for accelerated approval.

basis.text: The application was granted Priority Review.

summary.text: Erdafitinib, a breakthrough-therapy designated kinase inhibitor, received Priority Review and accelerated approval based on tumor response rate from the single-arm Phase 2 study BLC2001, with confirmatory Phase 3 trial BLC3001 required to verify clinical benefit.

requirement.text: 3561-1: Submit the analysis and datasets with final report demonstrating clinical benefit of erdafitinib from confirmatory Phase 3 trial BLC3001 comparing erdafitinib with vinflunine or docetaxel or pembrolizumab in advanced urothelial cancer with selected FGFR aberrations.

citations.quote: 3561-1 Submit the analysis, and datasets with the final report demonstrating clinical benefit of erdafitinib in patients with locally advanced and metastatic urothelial carcinoma with susceptible FGFR 3 or FGFR 2 genetic alterations from clinical trial BLC3001 entitled; “A Phase 3 Study of Erdafitinib Compared With Vinflunine or Docetaxel or Pembrolizumab in Subjects with Advanced Urothelial Cance

requirement.text: 3561-2: Complete and submit results of the ongoing hepatic impairment trial EDI1008 evaluating the effect of hepatic impairment on the pharmacokinetics of erdafitinib.

citations.quote: 3561-2 Complete and submit the results of your ongoing hepatic impairment trial EDI1008, entitled: "A Phase 1, Open-Label, Single-Dose Study to Evaluate the Effect of Hepatic Impairment on the Pharmacokinetics of Erdafinitib".

requirement.text: 3561-3: Conduct a clinical PK trial evaluating the effect of repeated doses of erdafitinib on the single-dose PK of a sensitive CYP3A substrate (e.g., midazolam) to determine appropriate dosing recommendations.

citations.quote: 3561-3 Conduct a clinical pharmacokinetic trial that evaluates the effect of repeated doses of erdafinitib on the single dose pharmacokinetics of a sensitive CYP3A substrate (e.g., midazolam), to address the potential for excessive drug toxicity or decreased drug exposure, and to determine appropriate dosing recommendations when coadministering erdafinitib with a sensitive CYP3A substrate.

requirement.text: 3561-4: Conduct a clinical PK trial evaluating the effect of repeated doses of a strong CYP2C9/CYP3A inducer (e.g., rifampin) on the single-dose PK of erdafitinib to determine appropriate dosing recommendations.

citations.quote: 3561-4 Conduct a clinical pharmacokinetic trial that evaluates the effect of repeated doses of a strong inducer (e.g., rifampin) of CYP2C9 and CYP3A on the single dose pharmacokinetics of erdafitinib to assess the magnitude of decreased drug exposure and to determine appropriate dosing recommendations when erdafitinib is coadministered with CYP2C9 and CYP3A inducers.

requirement.text: 3561-5: Conduct a clinical PK study evaluating the effect of repeated doses of erdafitinib (steady-state) on the single-dose PK of an OCT2 probe substrate to determine appropriate dosing recommendations for OCT2 substrates.

citations.quote: 3561-5 Conduct a clinical pharmacokinetic study that evaluates the effect of repeated doses of erdafitinib (at steady-state) on the single dose pharmacokinetics of a probe substrate of OCT2 to determine appropriate dosing recommendations for OCT2 substrate when it is coadministered with erdafitinib.
